claimMethod.description: how the identity was established: "attested" (a site-wide expert vouched for it on the record) or "committee" (the Steering Committee answered a claim the member filed). The old challenge-token route was removed because it required permissions at TASVideos that an inactive or banned account does not have.

attestedBy.description: the expert who made the call

attestation.description: how they verified it, publicly stated

claimedAtTime.description: arrival moment, seconds, UTC; date stays the day people read
